Theformationof solid solutionregionsfor thebinary compounds was notrevealed,andpractically no variation ofthelatticeparametersoftheternaryboridesintwo-and three-phase samples was observed (Table2). This factindicatesthat nohomogeneity ranges existfortheternary compounds.

The ternary compounds $\mathrm{Ln}_{2}\mathrm{NiB}_{10}$ whereLn-Y,Gd, Tb,Dy,Ho withthe $\mathrm{Th}_{2}\mathrm{NiB}_{10}$ structuretype were reportedin [12].We preparedthe sampleofthe composition $\mathrm{Er_{2}NiB_{10}}$ )to verifytheformationoftheboridewiththe same structure in the $\mathrm{Er-Ni-B}$ system. But the powder diffraction patternofthissample containedthelinesofthreebinary compounds $\left(\mathrm{ErB}_{4}+\mathrm{ErB}_{12}+\mathrm{NiB}\right)$ ),whichindicatestheab
sence of the ternary boride $\mathrm{Er}_{2}\mathrm{NiB}_{10}$ in the $\mathrm{Er-Ni-B}$ system (Table 2).

A compoundofthe composition $\mathrm{ErNiB_{4}}$ was reported to crystallize withtwo different structures:$\mathrm{ErNiB_{4}}$ [13] and $\mathrm{YCrB_{4}}$ [14]. This canindicate the existence ofpolymorphismforthisboride. Takingintoaccountthattheboride with the $\mathrm{ErNiB_{4}}$ type structure was found by a single-crystal method,andthattheboridewiththe $\mathrm{YCrB_{4}}$ type structure was found by $\mathrm{X}-\mathrm{ray}$ powder diffraction,weassumedthe high-temperature modification to have the $\mathrm{ErNiB_{4}}$ structure andthelow-temperature modification to havethe $\mathrm{YCrB_{4}}$ structure. Theresults of aDTA investigationrevealed atransition temperature of1540K.

A new compound of the approximate composition $\mathrm{ErNi_{8}B_{2}}$ with unknown structure was found. The X-ray powderpatternofthis compound differedfromthepowder patternsoftheknownternaryboridesfoundintheearlier studied $\mathrm{Ln}-\mathrm{Ni}-\mathrm{B}$ systems. This compoundexists onlyin the as-cast sample and decomposes into the $\mathrm{Er}_{2}\mathrm{Ni}_{21}\mathrm{B}_{6}$ and $\mathrm{ErNi_{4}B}$ compounds after annealing. Since the single crystals were not available its structure was not determined.

A further new compound was found in the as-cast samples containing16.6at.%Er. The X-raypowderpattern of this compound was very similar to the powder pattern of the $\mathrm{ErNi_{4}B}$ boride. The crystal structure of the new $\mathrm{Er_{0.917}Ni_{4.09}B}$ boride was determined using an X-ray single-crystal method: space group P6/mmm;$a=1.48399nm;c=0.69194nm$ [15]. This structure is very similar to the $\mathrm{Y}_{0.915}\mathrm{Ni}_{4.12}\mathrm{B}$ structure [16]. The $\mathrm{Er_{0.917}Ni_{4.09}B}$ boridedecomposesafterannealing,andthe main phase is the $\mathrm{ErNi_{4}B}$ compound.
